exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to chest, press up.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, grip bar wider than shoulders, lower to upper chest, press up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbells at chest level, press up and slightly together.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells up and together.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, arms extended with slight bend, lower in arc until chest stretch, bring together.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width, lower chest to floor, push up keeping body straight.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.instructions: Support on parallel bars, lean forward, lower until shoulders below elbows, push up.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: High pulleys, step forward, bring hands together in front of chest.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Sit, elbows at 90 degrees, bring pads together in front of chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width, squat until thighs parallel, drive up.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on front delts, elbows up, squat keeping torso upright.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Feet hip-width, grip bar outside legs, drive through heels, stand tall.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Slight knee bend, hinge at hips, lower bar to shin level, squeeze glutes up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width on platform, lower until 90 degrees, press without locking knees.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward, lower until both knees 90 degrees, push back to start.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rear foot elevated, lower front knee toward floor, drive through front heel.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Sit, pad on shins, extend legs fully, control down.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie/seat, pad on heels, curl toward glutes, control down.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Balls of feet on platform, lower heels, raise as high as possible.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back on bench, bar on hips, drive hips up, squeeze glutes at top.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar, pull until chin over bar, lower with control.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: Supinated grip, pull until chin over bar, lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips, pull bar to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: One knee on bench, pull dumbbell to hip, keep elbow close.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit, pull handle to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Wide grip, pull bar to upper chest, lean back slightly.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Rope at face height, pull toward face, separate hands, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Chest on pad, pull handle to chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Bar at shoulders, press overhead, lock out, lower to shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Seated or standing, press dumbbells overhead, lower to ear level.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Slight bend in elbows, raise arms to shoulder height, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Bent over, raise arms out to sides, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: Start palms facing you, press up rotating palms forward.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.instructions: Narrow grip, pull bar to chin height, elbows higher than wrists.

exercises.name: Shrug
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells, shrug shoulders to ears, hold, lower.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Supinated grip, curl bar to shoulders, lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Supinated grip, curl dumbbells, supinate at top, lower.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Neutral grip, curl dumbbells to shoulders, lower.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Arms on pad, curl weight up, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Rope or bar, elbows at sides, push down, squeeze triceps.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.instructions: Dumbbell overhead, lower behind head, extend up.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, lower bar to forehead, extend up.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands close forming diamond, lower chest to hands, push up.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms on ground, body straight, hold position.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to 90 degrees or higher, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sit, lean back, rotate torso side to side with weight.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Kneel, roll wheel forward keeping core tight, pull back.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel, rope behind head, crunch down bringing elbows to knees.
